items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: Who was in your band when you got married? ... Robbie Kirsch, Martin Kirsch...

ctx.x: Let me get everything. Right. Papa, who was in your band when you got married about that time? Who was in your band when you got married? When I got married? Mm-hmm.
Manuel Marlowe, Leo Marlowe, Robbie Kirsch, Martin Kirsch, Gussie Zinneman, and the Chinaman, and... Was that King Martin? Yeah. Kit Martin, Vega, Buck A., and the Shields.
So many of them. I couldn't remember. Yeah. Well, do you remember when Dave Hennessy got killed? He was the chief of police? Oh, yes.
